notes.title: Full Version of DEEEER Simulator: Your Average Everyday Deer Game Now Available!
notes.content:
Dear Users,

It's been too long a wait, but we are so happy to finally be able to bring you the full version of DEEEER Simulator!
[previewyoutube=7KplmjTjLKY;full][/previewyoutube]

The full version comes with a host of exciting new features and updates.
Along the way, many of you were kind enough to offer support and words of encouragement as we worked on development, and for that, words cannot express how thankful we are.
Well, without further ado, jump into the game to find out the fate that awaits our favorite average, everyday deer!
[list]
[*]Final boss
[*]Opening and ending sequence
[*]Newly added BGM composed by original artists
[*]Steam Achievements
[*]Additional Language Support
[/list]
Apart from the above, we have also incorporated many user requests and fixed a long list of minor bugs.

[h3]The Final Evolution of DEEEER DLC[/h3]
Want MOAR DEEEER?! (No, really - we'd actually like to know.)）
Unleash the full power of our deer friend with this DLC pack.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1801910/

[h3]16-Track Original Soundtrack also Available![/h3]
Enjoy these amazing and wacky tracks composed specifically for DEEEER Simulator!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1801900/

[h3]Fully Jacked DEEEER Edition[/h3]
Get the game along with the DLC pack and original soundtrack together for 10% off the total price! With so much DEEEER goodness in this bundle, you definitely won't regret it!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23731/

Now, go on and live your deer life to the fullest!

notes.title: DEEEER Simulator Full Release on 11/25!
notes.content:
Dear Users,

It's been a long time since DEEEER Simulator's Early Access release in January 2020 and after a long period of development, we are finally ready to release DEEEER Simulator's full version to all of you! 

The full version features an expanded storyline, taking you face to face with the final boss at the end.

Full Release Announcement Trailer:
[previewyoutube=gzvsASITILg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Seven Additional Languages![/b]

To bring this game to an even wider audience, the full version will feature full support for seven new languages!

Players all over the world will be able to enjoy DEEEER Simulator in English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Italian, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, and Russian.

The full version of DEEEER Simulator is coming to Steam on 11/25!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1018800/_DEEEER_Simulator/

notes.content:
Dear Fans,
Just your average everyday deer game, DEEEER Simulator, has finally been released into early access!

notes.title: Playsim will be at PAX WEST! Please come at our booth!
notes.content:
Dear all,

Playism will be at PAX WEST from August 29th!
Our booth number is [h1][b]6016[/b][/h1], and we will be exhibibting three games in addition to[i] Pixel Game Maker MV[/i]:

[h1]Deeeer Simulator[/h1]

## For the first time playable, [i]Deeeer Simulator[/i]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35140568/abdda6b883c70d8865a7eb2f56d6812043bd1d9e.gif[/img]
### Your Average Everyday Deer Game

Take on the role of the main character: a deer. Run around town freely taking advantage of the main character’s deer-specific attributes, such as your stretchy neck and your stabby antlers!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2K2mp2ZAA8w

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1018800/DEEEER_Simulator/

## [i]Outrider Mako[/i] and [i]Orangeblood [/i]demos will be available for the first time in English!

[h1]Orangeblood[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/2ac545fc68b70668939dfc9db3d5079c95c24535.gif[/img]

### “WELCOME TO NEW KOZA”

It's the end of the 20th century, on a different timeline. A manmade island off the coast of Okinawa is humming with a dirty, exotic vibe - and it's awesome!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042670/Orangeblood/

[h1]Outrider Mako [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35140568/67d493c28893fbe78792706c0896fbdb02f52fd1.gif[/img]

### Get ready to jump into battle and solve some mysteries!

In accordance with a deal made with the self-proclaimed ""delivery service"" and all-around mysterious entity known as Bumon, Mako has taken a job working as a lackey at the Bumon Delivery Corporation in ""Mayoi - the world of the gods.""

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hl8XX9QevTU

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1072400/Outrider_Mako/

[h1]Pixel Game Maker MV[/h1]

Pixel Game Maker MV, which's full release will be this year, will also be exhibited.
You can try the 4-player motorcycle game made with Pixel Game Maker MV and user-created action games!

Check out our Showcase video featuring user-created games:

https://youtu.be/-7dCFCmM52s

Create the game that you want to play now! 

Pixel Game Maker MV allows you to build up your own action game with no programming knowledge necessary. This engine was designed with the idea of giving a voice to people's passions, allowing them to freely express the game that they have held in their hearts.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/837510/Pixel_Game_Maker_MV__MV/

We look forward to meeting you at PAX WEST!
